incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: API gateway 5xx surge detected (alert: api_gateway_5xx_ratio > 1% for 5m) — routing to #incidents and paging oncall

Alex C.: acked. jumping in, checking dashboards

James (SRE): seeing a spike in 502s from the inference-proxy pool in us-west1, looks correlated with KV cache miss rate rising ~20m ago

Alex C.: repro steps? any recent deploys?

Emily (ProdOps): no deploys in last 3 hours, can confirm increased tail latency on embeddings and text-gen endpoints from customer telemetry

James (SRE): running `kubectl logs` on proxy-1 shows repeated upstream timeouts: `context deadline exceeded` and a bunch of `connection reset by peer`

Alex C.: routing next 15m to dedup and fallback policy. switching some traffic to smaller model variant to reduce load. tagging customers with elevated errors

incident-bot: note: oncall handoff requested: @Oncall Rotation will take bridge at +25m if still active

Maria G.: I'm on the bridge. pushing a quick canary to warm caches and enabling short-circuit fallback for heavy batch requests

James (SRE): added a temporary rate limit on long-run inference routes, dropping tail latency. monitoring for customer impact

Alex C.: update: 1) errors down 40% after warm-up, 2) some customers still seeing failed requests during peak bursts, 3) KV store read latency is elevated to ~150ms from 20ms baseline

Emily (ProdOps): opening customer impact thread -- encountered 8 distinct customers with ~5% request failures during 22:03-22:28 UTC window. CS notified and triaged to reduce noise

Maria G.: good. we should schedule a post-incident review tomorrow. Owner for postmortem? I can own timeline & customer comms. Need SRE to own root-cause and remediation plan

James (SRE): I can own the RCA + remediation tickets. initial hypothesis: KV hosts in us-west1 had a transient disk IO saturation, causing slow reads which cascaded into timeouts and proxy retries, amplifying load. Need to validate with metrics and disk alarms

Alex C.: agreement. action items while hot: 1) roll kv-hosts out of rotation (James), 2) add synthetic check for KV P95 read latency (Emily), 3) add temporary throttling rule for >8 concurrent long requests per key (Maria)

James (SRE): capturing logs and traces now. Will attach query and example spans to postmortem doc. Also enabling per-host IO metrics export to monitoring for 48h

Alex C.: quick question on paging noise — this alert fired right away and paged everyone. we should consider changing the pager policy to require either (a) 5m sustained errors + increase in backend latency OR (b) 2 independent alert signals. Otherwise we get noisy pages for transient flaps

incident-bot: reminder — bridge created: meeting link https://meet.internal/redwood/incident/1756001234 

Emily (ProdOps): I'm adding a follow-up: add a customer-level SLO check that cross-references error-rate with user impact before notifying CS. Also propose adding a 10m suppression window for alerts that resolve then re-appear within 2m (flake suppression)

Maria G.: for postmortem scheduling: propose the PIR tomorrow 14:00 UTC, 60m. I'll create doc and invite SRE, ProdOps, Observability, and Support.

Alex C.: assign owners here so we can track:
- James (SRE): RCA + remediation ticket(s) (ID: TBD)
- Emily (ProdOps): synthetic KV P95 check + dashboard panels
- Maria G.: temporary throttling rule + runbook update
- Alex C.: customer summary & comms

James (SRE): creating the RCA doc now -> linking in thread when ready. plan to include PromQL queries and a sequence diagram.

Emily (ProdOps): sample alert rule I'd like to propose (Prometheus):
```
alert: KVHighReadLatency
expr: avg_over_time(kv_read_latency_ms{region="us-west1"}[5m]) > 100
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "KV read latency p95 > 100ms in us-west1"
  runbook: "https://docs.internal/runbooks/kv-high-read-latency"
```

Maria G.: also propose changing pager for api_gateway_5xx_ratio to something like:
- threshold: >1% for 10m AND kv_read_latency_p95 > 80ms OR 2 distinct failure alerts within 5m
- on-call routing: page primary SRE only, escalate to oncall rotation after 10m if unresolved

Alex C.: +1. that should cut noise and ensure we don't wake the whole team for transient spikes. please push these changes as PRs to monitor-config repo and ping observability for review

incident-bot: note: postmortem scheduled by Maria G. for 2025-11-05T14:00:00Z (tentative) — doc created at https://docs.internal/pir/1756001234 

James (SRE): logging action items in tracker: https://jira.internal/browse/RED-4582 (RCA), RED-4583 (kv infra hardening), RED-4584 (monitoring tweaks)

Emily (ProdOps): I'll add the synthetic test and dashboard card, aiming EOD tomorrow.

Maria G.: I'll draft the customer-facing summary and the internal timeline. want to ensure the message includes fallback mechanisms we used and ETA for remediation

Alex C.: final note before handoff: Oncall Rotation will take bridge at +25m. If you need long-run assistance, escalate to paging policy (sre-lead). Thanks all for quick mitigation. :white_check_mark:

Oncall Rotation: acked and taking bridge now. continuing verification of remediation steps and keeping customers updated via CS channel

incident-bot: incident resolved: api gateway errors returned to baseline at 22:45 UTC — case closed pending postmortem.

Maria G.: thank you everyone. will follow up with invites and doc links. please add any missing evidence or logs to the PIR doc before the meeting.

James (SRE): added initial traces and PromQL snippets to PIR doc. will populate root cause timeline tonight

Emily (ProdOps): adding runbook patch and alert PRs first thing tomorrow morning.

Alex C.: closing thread — see you at PIR. :wave:
